title: Even If & No Matter: 即使 / 就算 / 哪怕…也, 不管 / 无论…都, 任何, 一个也不
description: Concessions that hold even in the worst case, 'whatever / however', any, and 'not even one'.

points.title: 即使 / 就算 / 哪怕 … 也 …: even if
points.summary: Three ways to say 'even if' — all pair with 也. 就算 is spoken, 即使 neutral, 哪怕 emphasises an extreme.
points.body:
- **即使**明天下雨，我**也**要去.
- **哪怕**再忙，你**也**要吃饭.
examples: Even if I fail, I want to try.

points.title: 不管 / 无论 … 都 / 也 …: no matter
points.summary: 不管 / 无论 + a question element (怎么, 多, 谁, A不A, 还是) + 都 / 也. Unlike 即使, it needs an open alternative.
points.body:
- **不管**天气怎么样，他**都**去跑步.
- **无论**多难，我**都**要学下去.
examples: Whether you go or not, I'm going.

points.title: 任何 + noun + 都 / 也: any
points.summary: 任何 (rènhé) + noun (+ 都 / 也) = any …; in negatives 'not any'.
points.body:
- 这里**任何**人**都**可以参加.
- 我没有**任何**问题.

points.title: 一 + MW (+ noun) + 也 / 都 + 不 / 没: not a single one
points.summary: Strong negation: 一个人也不认识 (don't know a single person).
points.body:
- 我**一个人也不**认识.
- 他**一口也没**喝.
examples: I don't know a single person.

notes: 即使 pairs with 也, not 就.
questions.translation: Even if it rains tomorrow, I'm going.
However busy you are, you must eat on time.

questions.prompt: Which one means 'Even if I fail, I'll try'?
notes: = 'Only if I fail will I try'.
= 'As long as I fail, I'll try' — illogical.
questions.translation: Even if I fail, I want to try.

notes: 不管 pairs with 都 / 也.
questions.translation: Whatever the weather, he goes running.

notes: 即使 needs one condition, not an alternative.
虽然 states one fact — it can't take 去不去.
questions.translation: Whether you go or not, I'm going.

notes: 无论 pairs with 都 / 也.
无论 needs a question element (多难, not 很难).
虽然 doesn't take 多 + adj or 都.
questions.translation: However hard it is, I'll keep learning.

questions.prompt: What does 「{这里|zhèlǐ}{任何|rènhé}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{可以|kěyǐ}{参加|cānjiā}。」 mean?

notes: 任何 goes before the noun.
任何 goes before the noun.
任何 goes before the noun.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{来|lái}{这|zhè}{个|ge}{城市|chéngshì}，{一|yí}{个|ge}{人|rén}（　）{不|bú}{认识|rènshi}。
notes: 一个人就不认识 isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: I've just arrived in this city and don't know a single person.

questions.prompt: Which one means 'He didn't drink a single sip'?
questions.translation: He didn't drink a single sip.
